name: Soulrend's tooltip states the Soul Infusion requirement its client data omits (#7667)
contract: Soulrend 573316 and every later rank carry Spell.dbc CasterAuraSpell 803031
(Soul Infusion), which Reaped Soul 500363 grants at three stacks, so the cast is
rejected with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURAS (22) until the infusion exists and it
spends the infusion and the three souls. The client's own description names
neither, while its 'Requires Melee Weapon' line comes from the spell's own
attributes, so #7667 asks the tooltip to state the requirement as the Reaper's
other formation-gated abilities do. The client's Spell.dbc cannot be edited from
this repository, so the fix publishes each rank's unchanged DBC text with the
conditional 'Requires Soul Infusion' prefix in coa_client_spell_description,
which AscensionCompat streams to the client as SMSG_PATCH_SPELL (opcode 2346) at
login. This scenario reads the streamed rows and then proves the text is true:
row 500639 (Runeshroud, published by the same table) is the control for the
stream and must not gain the line, 573316 must arrive with it, and the same
Soul Infusion the line names must gate the cast and be spent by it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI, level scaling and the login patch stream settle
CONTROL: the shared description table still streams Runeshroud's own text as row 500639
CONTROL: that streamed row carries no Soul Infusion requirement line
STREAM: Soulrend rank 1 (573316) reaches the client with the requirement line
STREAM: that row also names the Reaped Souls the cast spends
STREAM: the rank-2 description still reaches the client with the same line
STREAM: the level-12 chain member 802731 carries it too
CONTROL: every other streamed description is untouched - 501546 keeps its own prerequisite
Learn the rank the report used
Empty the Runic Power bar so the cast's generation is visible
Soulrend without the infusion the tooltip now names
The line is true: the infusion gates the cast (SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURAS)
and no Soulrend damage lands
Three Reaped Souls, the stacks the line names
The three souls grant Soul Infusion 803031
Soulrend with the infusion
The infused Soulrend lands
The cast spends the infusion the tooltip names
and spends the three Reaped Souls
and generates Runic Power, as the unchanged description still promises
